observable_definition: Share of sampled frames containing one person in a close or medium shot.
potential_research_use: Media framing, attention allocation, visibility, and gatekeeping.
main_limitation: Does not identify why the producer selected the shot or whether the visible person is the active speaker.

observable_definition: Share of sampled frames with multiple people visible and at least one person looking toward another visible person.
potential_research_use: Relational engagement, audience access, and visible interaction structure.
main_limitation: Sparse frames and uncertain gaze targets make this a conservative measure.

observable_definition: Share of person observations with a raised, open, pointing, or otherwise visibly active hand.
potential_research_use: Embodied communication, idea depiction, and persuasive presentation.
main_limitation: Tight crops hide hands; the measure is not passion, charisma, or confidence.

observable_definition: Continuous FFmpeg scene changes divided by video duration.
potential_research_use: Production intensity, media packaging, and presentation format.
main_limitation: A scene-score threshold is a measurement choice; fades and screen graphics may be counted as cuts.

observable_definition: Share of speaker changes with a detected camera cut within two seconds.
potential_research_use: How production follows and structures conversational attention.
main_limitation: The two-second window and scene threshold should be varied in robustness tests.

observable_definition: Observed share of speaker changes with a cut within two seconds minus the mean from a within-video circular-shift null.
potential_research_use: Whether production follows conversational floor changes beyond the coincidence expected from a video's editing rate.
main_limitation: The null preserves transition spacing but is not a causal model of editorial decision-making.

observable_definition: Share of automatically labeled interviewer-to-guest transitions accompanied by a cut within two seconds.
potential_research_use: Media gatekeeping and the visual transfer of the floor from questioner to respondent.
main_limitation: Depends on automatic interviewer and guest labels, which require human validation.

observable_definition: Difference in active-speech pitch and intensity variability when a raised hand is visible versus not visible.
potential_research_use: Cross-modal reinforcement and multimodal presentation strategies.
main_limitation: The visible person is not reliably linked to the active speaker, so this is co-occurrence rather than individual synchrony.
